committed_before: any code of the four fixes below was written, and before the held-out sample (search seed 20261120) was drawn
question: Four faults of the certificate, outside the calibration table's key, found on a sandbox sample of 40 freshly drawn laws (a_design's campaign, search seed 20261119, 256 and 1,024 nodes, two seeds each, 160 seeds): does each fix give the known answer on chains built to have one, and on 40 other laws does it move only what its fault moved?
decided: the operator, 2026-11-19 about 03:00 local, asked whether 'every graph must stop changing' is a good rule and said the choice was beyond them; the agent decided, the evidence to be shown: one standard of stationarity at both temperatures (a chain's measurements stop drifting, not its edges), and the late energy's drift in its own errors

found_on_the_first_sample.zero_temperature: 59 seeds certified AT_REST; in 19 of them (7 laws) a deciding chain still made more than 0.05 accepted changes a node in its late window (up to 39), every one a neutral move; read over the same late window as the rest reading (from 85% of the chain's moves), the structural trend drifted beyond 3 errors and its floor in 1 seed (law 12, 256 nodes, seed 0). Today the zero-temperature certificate reads no structure at all, and the trend it computes beside it is read from 40% of the points, a window in which a chain still falling is not at rest, so it flagged chains that accepted nothing late
found_on_the_first_sample.drift: the late energy drift is divided by the mean absolute energy (floor 1) and failed above 0.5: on 512 finite-temperature chain chunks it failed 50; measured in the chain's own errors, widened for lag-one correlation as the structural trend is, 131 drift beyond 3, so 81 pass today that drift; shifting every energy by a constant changed 16 of today's 512 verdicts; of 17 certified seeds, 2 have a chain beyond 3 errors (3.3 and 3.4)
found_on_the_first_sample.split: on two frozen laws (23 and 26) the twins' late energies a node differed by 1e-10 relative, a difference of rounding, and the split divided it by its floor of 1e-12: z of 160 to 1,341, STARTS_DISAGREED on every chunk to the x64 cap
found_on_the_first_sample.cap: no seed of the sample first passed at the cap; one passed at x56 and failed its confirmation at x64. The rule asks two passes in a row, so a seed whose first pass is at the cap can never be certified

the_fixes.zero_temperature: a chain at rest is one whose energy stopped falling (as today) and whose structure stopped drifting: the structural trend of every deciding chain, read over the rest reading's own late window (from the move the engine's late accounting starts at), within 3 of its widened errors or under its floor, as at finite temperature
the_fixes.drift: a chain's late energy drift (its last 30% of points) is measured in its own standard errors, widened for lag-one correlation exactly as the structural trend's are, and fails beyond equilibration_split_z (3); the energy's size no longer enters, so a constant added to every energy changes nothing
the_fixes.split: a difference of means is set to zero when it is within rounding: 1e-9 of the larger of the two means' sizes and 1, so two chains equal to rounding agree whatever their spread
the_fixes.cap: a seed whose chunk at the cap passes runs further chunks at the cap until it has the passes in a row the rule asks, or fails one
